subject: Re: Commitment letter / PO matrix, monthly sweep & credit holdback
messages:
From: Adam Levin <adam@clearshore.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@clearshore.com>
Date: Sun, 19 Apr 2026 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: PO format / commitment letter questions

Hi Logan —

Thanks for the updated pricing and the commitment letter your AE shared. Procurement had a couple of gating items before we can issue the PO: a required PO header with our internal project code, monthly sweep of invoices to a single ledger account (not per-entity), and a standard 10% holdback on first two invoices until integration acceptance. Also, we need net45 payment terms reflected on the invoice.

Can you confirm Redwood can:
- Accept our PO header fields in the PO (I attached our template)
- Issue consolidated monthly invoices to our corporate ledger
- Apply a 10% holdback for first two invoices and then release on month 3
- Show net45 on the invoice and accept monthly sweep (not weekly)

If these are OK we can route an internal approval and get the PO out next week.

Best,
Adam
Purchasing Manager, ClearShore Health
From: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>
To: Adam Levin <adam@clearshore.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO format / commitment letter questions

Adam —

Thanks for the clear list. High-level responses:

- PO header: yes, we can ingest your PO template as long as the PO number, project code, and ship-to (billing entity) are present in the header fields. Our finance team maps custom fields from the PO into our ERP during onboarding.
- Consolidated monthly invoices: yes, we can issue a single monthly invoice to your corporate ledger. We will map to the ledger account you identify in the PO.
- 10% holdback: we can accommodate a temporary holdback for the first two invoices. We typically model that as a credit hold on the invoice remainder and then release via a manual credit memo in month 3 after acceptance.
- Net45: acceptable. We will mark invoices Net 45; please confirm your cut-off day for month-end so invoice date aligns with your payment runs.

I've looped Vanessa (sales lead) and Ben (finance ops) to confirm the mechanics and any paperwork needed. Vanessa — can Redwood sign the commitment letter with the holdback clause and provide a milestone acceptance definition for ClearShore to reference? Ben — can your team ingest ClearShore_PO_Template.xlsx and confirm whether the PO header mapping will cause any delay to onboarding?

Thanks,
Logan Wright
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Adam Levin <adam@clearshore.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Apr 2026 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO format / commitment letter questions

Adam —

Appreciate the clarity. A few practical notes from a commercial / discount perspective:

- The 10% holdback will impact our effective upfront recognition. We can accept the holdback for the first two invoices if we keep the pricing as quoted, but if ClearShore requires the holdback plus an extension to Net60, we would need to revise the discount slab by 3% across years 1–2 to offset the working capital impact.
- Consolidated monthly billing is fine — please confirm whether the monthly sweep should be on the 1st business day or the 5th. If it's the 1st, we may need to align our cut-off to ensure all usage through the last calendar day is included.
- For the commitment letter: we will add a clause that defines acceptance criteria for integration (basic API connectivity + smoke test results) and a release of holdback upon written acceptance. We typically define acceptance as: production key issued + three successful test runs that match qualitative output (we can add a 48-hour remediation window).

If ClearShore is happy to proceed with the quoted rates and the above holdback mechanics, we can sign the commitment letter and we will issue the PO-ready invoice schedule. If you need alternate net terms or a different holdback cadence, flag it now and we will run a quick commercial impact.

Regards,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

---
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior AE — Redwood Inference
T: (415) 555-0148 | vanessa@redwood.com
From: Claire Young <claire.young@clearshore.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>
Cc: Adam Levin <adam@clearshore.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@clearshore.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Apr 2026 08:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO format / commitment letter questions

Vanessa / Logan —

Thanks — the proposal is reasonable. A few follow-ups from procurement / legal:

1) Cut-off: monthly sweep should be processed on the 3rd business day of the following month (Finance constraint). Can Redwood set invoice dates so that charges from the prior month all consolidate to that invoice?
2) Holdback wording: legal would prefer the holdback be described as "retention of 10% of each of the first two invoices" with release "upon written confirmation of integration acceptance". That language works with our standard payment run.
3) Invoice fields: please include our ERP project code in the PO header and also as a line-level custom attribute called "CSH_ProjectCode" so our ledger can auto-map.

We are OK to sign the commitment letter with the holdback as long as Redwood does not change the quoted price and the release mechanics are clear. I attached the signed quote (v2) — could you countersign and return?

Claire
Head of Procurement, ClearShore Health

---
Attachment: ClearShore_PO_Template.xlsx (template)
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Claire Young <claire.young@clearshore.com>, Adam Levin <adam@clearshore.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 23 Apr 2026 09:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO format / commitment letter questions

Claire —

Finance confirms we can:
- Set invoice date to the last calendar day of each month and produce a consolidated invoice that ClearShore will pay on the 3rd business day of the following month (Net45 reflected on the invoice).
- Map the CSH_ProjectCode from the PO header and a line-level field; the template you supplied is compatible. We will ask for the PO number and project code at time of submission to expedite mapping.
- Apply a 10% retention on the first two invoices and issue a credit memo releasing the retained amount upon written confirmation of acceptance (we will provide the credit memo in month 3).

Next steps for signature: Logan / Vanessa — please countersign the attached commitment-letter-draft.docx with the retention language described by Claire and upload to DocuSign (link below). Claire / Adam — once we have the countersigned commitment and your PO with the CSH_ProjectCode, finance will provision the account and schedule first invoice generation.

Ben Carter

Redwood Inference
